name: Lusha
description: Lusha is a business intelligence platform for finding, enriching and monitoring company and professional contact data. Sales, recruiting and go-to-market teams use it to research accounts, reveal business contact details, build prospect lists and act on market signals.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated customer-owned Lusha API key. Agents can read only a reduced account-governance snapshot covering credits, plan, rate limits and pricing; contact/company data, prospecting, signals, website visits, webhooks, provider-hosted MCP and raw API access remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: LUSHA_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Lusha API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned API key created by an authorized Admin or Manager in Lusha API Hub. Relay encrypts it and permits only the fixed account-usage route.

capabilities.label: Read account usage
capabilities.description: Read a reduced snapshot of credits, plan, rate limits and action pricing without accessing business-profile data.

allowed.label: Read account usage
allowed.description: Read the connected Lusha account's credits, plan, rate limits and action pricing without searching or revealing business-profile data.

blocked.label: Block business-profile data
blocked.description: Contact and company search, enrichment, search-and-enrich, decision makers, PII reveal and all profile data are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block prospecting and automation
blocked.description: Prospecting, filters, lookalikes, recommendations, signals, website visits, CRM workflows, exports, outreach and bulk operations are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block webhooks, administration and raw access
blocked.description: Webhook subscriptions, delivery logs, webhook secrets, opt-out subscriptions, API-key management, provider-hosted MCP, arbitrary API, retries, pagination and browser sessions are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The reduced account-usage read runs automatically. Business-profile data, prospecting, automation, webhooks, administration, MCP and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same single bounded governance read runs without approval; the full-account API key never expands Relay's fixed account-usage route.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts exactly one parameterless account-governance read while Railway alone holds the customer API key.
Relay mounts exactly one parameterless account-governance read while Railway alone holds the customer API key.

providerSetup.blocker: An eligible customer Lusha plan, authorized Admin or Manager, dedicated API key, current API terms/privacy review, Railway staging entry, live Account Usage schema validation, disconnect rotation and post-rotation denial remain for a separate authorized provider task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized provider task must confirm plan eligibility and the usage-only purpose, review current API terms and privacy notice, create a dedicated key in Lusha API Hub, store it in Railway staging, and validate only GET /v3/account/usage, parameter rejection, five-per-minute behavior, reduced output, no contact/company/profile data, no retries/pagination/MCP, encrypted-copy deletion, provider-side key rotation and post-rotation denial.

evidence.supports: Lusha documents V3's broad search, enrichment, prospecting, signals, lookalikes, website visits, webhooks and account surfaces, API-key authentication in the api_key header, plan-specific limits and fixed HTTPS JSON APIs.
Lusha documents GET /v3/account/usage as a five-requests-per-minute read returning credits, plan dates, rate-limit state and per-action pricing.
Lusha documents credit charging by search, revealed fields, signals, lookalikes and webhooks, plus the separate Account Usage limit and API errors. Relay blocks every credit-consuming data action.
Lusha documents an official provider-hosted OAuth MCP for named clients and API-key MCP for custom clients. Relay blocks raw MCP because no Relay distribution/tool-schema contract is published.
Lusha's responsible-use guidance requires a lawful purpose, compliance with API terms and privacy law, security safeguards, deletion handling and no spam or data-broker uses.
Lusha's API License Terms bind customer and authorized users to the applicable order, API service restrictions and incorporated privacy terms.

Lusha's current privacy notice describes its B2B contact database, customer/end-user processing, legal bases, retention, suppression, access, rectification and deletion rights. Relay's V1 returns no contact data.
